style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2ft Pre Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Straight from the snowy woods, our Indoor 60cm Pre-Lit Christmas Tree celebrates the winter season in style. At 60cm high, this tree features faux fir branches flocked with snow effect and is entwined with warm white LEDs on a green cable to give the foliage a gorgeous glow. Put this tree up on a wide windowsill for a cosy seasonal effect. To illuminate, simply insert 3 AA batteries into the battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the 6-hour timer function for an automatic shine at the same time each evening. You should expect 30 – 50 hours of illumination time from your batteries before they will need refreshing.&nbsp;</p><ul><li>(H) 60cm&nbsp;</li><li>Lead Wire: 20cm&nbsp;</li><li>30 LEDs&nbsp;</li><li>Requires 3 x AA batteries (sold separately)&nbsp;</li><li>Indoor Battery Decoration&nbsp;</li><li>Optional 6-hour timer</li><li>Size: ONE</li></ul>
